version: blocks-express-test answer key R v1 (catalogue router)

scoring.unit: per reply: routed id (exact slug from the list), null, invalid_id (not in list), or malformed (no parseable JSON with key 'catalogue'). correct = routed value is in the brief's accept list (null counts only where accept has null). invalid_id and malformed are wrong.
scoring.groups: block (B1-B6, clear), cross (B8,X1-X6, clear), null (X7), judgement (B7,X8). Each reported separately; no blended mean. Also reported: non-block briefs sent to bricks (false positives) and block briefs not sent to bricks (misses).
scoring.downstream: Step 2 (block agent) is NOT a model call here. Where the router chose a2ui-bricks-v1 for a B-brief, the already-measured P Express reply for the same repeat is re-scored with the P key (informational, labelled REUSED). Elsewhere: 'agent step not run'.

B7.rule: accept a2ui-bricks-v1: the LDraw real-parts engine (brick_build_3d) is in that pack. JUDGEMENT cell: reported separately, no pass rate in the headline.
B7.note: In the profiled P condition the block agent REFUSES B7 (slice P3 excludes brick_build_3d). Routing to bricks is right for the router; a refusal downstream is a separate question (not scored here).

B8.rule: expected a2ui-charts-v1 (sales dashboard with a bar chart)

X2.rule: expected a2ui-atoms-v1 (base has form, form_input, form_textarea; no other catalogue has form atoms). Base is always resolved, so a base answer means no extension slice is needed.

X4.rule: expected a2ui-aviation-v1 (adsb_feed, geo_mercator_radar). Our example was a departures board; replaced by an ADS-B radar brief because fids_board is in atom-packs.yaml but not in the published index the router sees.

X7.rule: expected null: not a request for an interface, no catalogue fits. Caveat: base could render text; the router prompt says null for non-UI requests, so a base answer counts as wrong here.

X8.rule: accept-set {marketing (feature_matrix, comparison_grid, versus_block), display (side_by_side_spec)}. JUDGEMENT cell: two catalogues acceptable.
